text: 10月8-9日，中国商务部部长王文涛与欧盟委员会贸易和经济安全委员马罗什·谢夫乔维奇在北京共同主持召开中欧贸易投资磋商机制（以下简称机制）第二次例会。双方围绕贸易和投资平衡、出口管制、知识产权、世贸组织改革等议题开展对等、专业、建设性的会谈，全面盘点了机制首次会议以来的磋商情况及各项进展，并形成了成果共识。商务部欧洲司负责人就相关成果进行解读。
text_en: On October 8-9, Chinese Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao and European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security Maros Sefcovic co-chaired the second meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism (the Mechanism) in Beijing. The two sides held reciprocal, professional and constructive talks on topics including trade and investment balance, export controls, intellectual property rights and WTO reform, comprehensively reviewed the consultations and progress since the first meeting of the Mechanism, and reached consensus on outcomes. An official of the European Affairs Department of the Ministry of Commerce interpreted the relevant outcomes.
